title: Cambridge IELTS 17 — Test 1 Listening
description: Đề lẻ, chỉ có Reading và Listening — không có Writing và Speaking nên không thi thử full được. Chọn một trong hai kỹ năng để làm. Cả hai đều chấm ngay theo đáp án và ra band luôn. Phần Listening dùng một file ghi âm liền cho cả bốn phần.

organising transport to and from the farm

a sheep that was having difficulty giving birth.

Labyrinths
Definition
•   a winding spiral path leading to a central area

    −	[32]                    is needed to navigate through a maze
    −	the word ‘maze’ is derived from a word meaning a feeling of [33]

    −	they have frequently been used in [34]                        and prayer

Early examples of the labyrinth spiral
  Ancient carvings on [35]
•	                                            have been found across
      many cultures

       [37]                    at its centre

Labyrinths nowadays

•   Popular with patients, visitors and staff in hospitals
